classification.difficultyReason: Keep two container quantities distinct, count their coefficients and loose pills, and translate between expressions and drawings in both directions.

content.prompt:
Each cup contains $x$ pills. Each bottle contains $y$ pills.
Write the total number of pills in each scenario.

spec.description: One cup on the left and one bottle labelled PILLS on the right.
spec.mathematics: One group of x pills and one group of y pills.
spec.answerVisibility: Objects are permanent givens; the expression is answer-only.

answer.worked: The cup contains $x$ pills and the bottle contains $y$ pills. Total: $x+y$.

spec.description: One cup followed by two bottles, each labelled PILLS.
spec.mathematics: One group of x pills and two groups of y pills.
spec.answerVisibility: Objects are permanent givens; the expression is answer-only.

answer.worked: The cup contains $x$ pills and the two bottles contain $2y$ pills. Total: $x+2y$.

spec.description: One cup, two bottles labelled PILLS, then two loose pills.
spec.mathematics: One group of x pills, two groups of y pills and two individual pills.
spec.answerVisibility: Objects are permanent givens; the expression is answer-only.

answer.worked: The cup contains $x$ pills, the bottles contain $2y$ pills and there are $2$ loose pills. Total: $x+2y+2$.

spec.description: Three bottles labelled PILLS in a horizontal row.
spec.mathematics: Three equal groups of y pills.
spec.answerVisibility: Objects are permanent givens; the expression is answer-only.

answer.worked: Each bottle contains $y$ pills, so three bottles contain $3y$ pills.

spec.description: Three loose pills precede one cup and two bottles labelled PILLS.
spec.mathematics: Three individual pills, one group of x pills and two groups of y pills, in source order.
spec.answerVisibility: Objects are permanent givens; the expression is answer-only.

answer.worked: There are $3$ loose pills, $x$ pills in the cup and $2y$ pills in the bottles. Total: $3+x+2y$.

spec.description: Two cups, three bottles labelled PILLS and one loose pill, from left to right.
spec.mathematics: Two groups of x pills, three groups of y pills and one individual pill.
spec.answerVisibility: Objects are permanent givens; the expression is answer-only.

answer.worked: The cups contain $2x$ pills, the bottles contain $3y$ pills and there is $1$ loose pill. Total: $2x+3y+1$.
$x$ represents one cup, $y$ represents one bottle and $5$ represents five loose pills.

spec.description: A complete example drawing with one cup, one bottle labelled PILLS and five loose pills.

answer.worked: $5x$ represents five cups, $2y$ represents two bottles and $2$ represents two loose pills.

spec.description: A complete example drawing: five cups above two bottles labelled PILLS and two loose pills.
spec.mathematics: Represents 5x+2y+2; arranging the objects in two rows preserves their counts.

answer.worked: $x$ represents one cup and $3y$ represents three bottles.

spec.description: A complete example drawing with one cup and three bottles labelled PILLS.

answer.worked: $3x$ represents three cups, $2y$ represents two bottles and $4$ represents four loose pills.

spec.description: A complete example drawing: three cups and two bottles labelled PILLS above four loose pills.
spec.mathematics: Represents 3x+2y+4; arranging the objects in two rows preserves their counts.
